decision: SOURCE-SPECIFIC NO-GO / SHELVE numerical subgroup stage
validity: Current main13 cohort lacks a valid EWSR1-versus-TAF15 partition; all13 grades are unavailable. Existing6/10/4 arrays lack direct partner maps. One historical candidate EWSR1 case does not create a comparator.
value: Broad fusion-partner neural-expression and TAF15/high-grade associations are published prior art. No useful unreported complete fixed-family conditional contrast is presently identifiable.
negative_evidence: The specific S1 and v1.0.1 metadata schemas do not supply needed partner labels; this is a source limitation, not biological equality or absence of partner effects.
inconclusive_evidence: Brenca has real native group labels but full case/condition-to-panel measurement links and donor overlap are unresolved; other public native cohorts remain suitable pending where stated.
reopening_conditions: An authoritative public specimen-to-partner and RNA-column crosswalk resolves at least two meaningful groups, with all relevant conditions/donor reuse retained
Available grade/sex/handling/lesion information allows an honest association estimand, or a justified limitation that still adds useful RNA evidence
A concrete experiment-changing contrast beyond published neural-program prior art is agreed before new outputs
New exact analytical freeze and root authorization; independent source/unit and value review; all12 family and unfavorable/inconclusive outcomes retained
original_R8_decisions: Preserved; no target-allocation rescue or post hoc high-SEZ6 subgroup selection.
